Susan Findlay is the Director and Senior Lecturer at NLSSM, The North London School of Sports Massage.

After discovering a love of teaching from running multiple health programs for the NHS, Susan gained her qualification in Sports and Remedial Massage and formed her own school, NLSSM, in 2004.

As well as teaching, Susan still runs her own practice from North London, believing that 'keeping up with the real world helps to keep me inspired, and that helps to make me a better teacher'.

This channel aims to help you become the best therapist you can be. It brings expert videos detailing unique tips, techniques and advice, all from Susan herself. For videos straight to your inbox, you can ign up to Susan's #massagemondays here: https://bit.ly/3oYBMFP 

Feel free to get in touch at info@susanfindlay.co.uk with any questions or even just for a chat!
